error.message: 校园模型网络请求失败；请检查校园网络/VPN 后重试。

limits: No complete live SAFETY audit or advisory accepted.
No live REVISE or REASSESS executed.
No token usage or monetary charge measured.
The guard deliberately suppressed the built-in retry after HTTP 502; the final network error wording therefore includes the guard effect.
Actual HTTP body length and response-header correlation IDs were not captured and cannot be supplied retrospectively.

failure_diagnostics.request_message_bytes_definition: Sum of UTF-8 byte lengths of messages[*].content, recorded by SafetyAgent. Excludes JSON framing/escaping, message roles, model parameters and HTTP headers. Not the actual HTTP body length.
failure_diagnostics.response_header_note: The original observer recorded only role, status and time to response headers. Correlation IDs cannot be recovered from these records. This does not mean the response had no correlation header.
failure_diagnostics.component_elapsed_note: Elapsed since the safety assessment started; includes the first successful tool-read turn and the blocked automatic retry. Not solely second-request duration.
failure_diagnostics.guard_effect: First 502 was real. Subsequent automatic retry was rejected locally before transmission; final application network-error wording includes this guard effect.
